pr_body:
This commit fixes a failure in BlockAccountingTests, and adds a new filter test scenario that filters on the last position of a multivalue.

closes  #100586
pr_title: ESQL: fix BlockAccountingTests and add a new filter test scenario

review_comment: We're building block arrays directly in the test (rather than using a builder), and must construct a valid structured block so that we can filter on it. A block with firstValuesIndex must have a final element entry to hold the end of the final position. This is why we +1 here - each position entry has just one entry, and the last has the final end position.  Note: builders do this for you, but we want to be more specific in this test. A separate test scenario verifies filtering on the final position.
subsequent filtering is on position 1, so we must have at least two positions in our data.
